app.title: Taa-Thip Navigator
app.subtitle: Voice navigation for people with visual impairment

language.noVoiceSpoken: No English voice is installed on this device. The closest available voice will be used. For clearer speech, install an English voice in your device settings.

permission.title: This app needs your location
permission.body: GPS provides your location for directions. Searches and route requests send data to external map providers. This app does not record route history. Choose a voice mode and test it before starting.
permission.startButtonHint: Tap to allow location access and enable spoken guidance
permission.spoken: Welcome to Taa-Thip Navigator. This app needs G P S to guide you by voice. Tap the button in the middle of the screen to allow it.

gps.acquiringSpoken: Finding your location. Please wait a moment.
gps.poorAccuracySpoken: Weak G P S signal. Your position may be off by about {{meters}} meters. Try moving to an open area away from tall buildings.
gps.recoveredSpoken: G P S signal is accurate again.
gps.staleSpoken: No G P S update for a while. The position shown may be out of date. Please walk with extra care.

maneuver.uturn: make a U-turn and walk back

search.label: Search for a destination
search.placeholder: Type a place name, e.g. Siam Paragon
search.noResultsSpoken: No places found. Try a different or shorter name.
search.resultsSpoken_one: Found {{count}} place. Tap it to choose your destination.
search.resultsSpoken_other: Found {{count}} places. Tap one to choose your destination.
search.hint: Enter at least 2 characters, then press Search.

nav.calculatingSpoken: Calculating a walking route. Please wait a moment.
nav.routeReadySpoken: Route to {{destination}} found. Distance {{distance}}, about {{minutes}} minutes on foot.
nav.fallbackWarningSpoken: Warning. This route was calculated for cars because the walking route service is temporarily unavailable. There may be no sidewalk along parts of it. Please walk with extra care.
nav.stepInstruction: Follow the route for about {{distance}}, then {{maneuver}}
nav.stepInstructionWithStreet: Follow the route for about {{distance}}, then {{maneuver}} near {{street}}
nav.maneuverNow: Near the point to {{maneuver}}. Check your surroundings first.
nav.arrivedSpoken: Near the end of the route to {{destination}}. Check the actual entrance.
nav.arrivedNearSpoken: You have reached the end of the route. {{destination}} is about {{distance}} away. The walking route only goes this far. Please ask someone nearby for help to stay safe.
nav.offRouteSpoken: Your position is off the route. Stop somewhere safe while a new route is checked.
nav.stoppedSpoken: Navigation stopped. You can choose a new destination.
nav.paused: Walking guidance paused: location or audio is not ready. Stop somewhere safe. Check GPS and test audio before continuing.
nav.resumed: Guidance is available again. Check your surroundings before continuing.
nav.confirmTurn: Confirm I have passed this turn
nav.safetyNote: Use with a cane or guide dog. This app cannot detect vehicles, obstacles or crossing signals, or tell you it is safe to cross. Keep the app visible during use.

whereAmI.failedSpoken: Could not find an address for this location. You may be offline. Please try again.
whereAmI.noPositionSpoken: Your location is not known yet. Please wait while the app finds it.

map.label: Map showing your current location
map.recenterSpoken: The map is back on your location
map.followingOn: The map is following your location
map.followingOff: The map has stopped following your location
map.showResults: Show search results on the map

actions.statusSpoken: Tracking your location. Accuracy is about {{meters}} meters.

errors.PERMISSION_DENIED: Location access was denied, so the app cannot guide you
errors.PERMISSION_DENIED_SPOKEN: Location access was denied. Please allow location for this site in your browser settings, then tap the retry button.
errors.POSITION_UNAVAILABLE_SPOKEN: No G P S signal. You may be indoors or in a shielded area. Please move to an open space and try again.
errors.TIMEOUT: Finding your location took too long
errors.TIMEOUT_SPOKEN: Finding your location took too long. Please tap the retry button.
errors.UNSUPPORTED: This browser does not support location
errors.UNSUPPORTED_SPOKEN: This browser does not support location. Please open the app in another browser such as a recent Chrome or Safari.
errors.INSECURE_CONTEXT_SPOKEN: This app needs a secure H T T P S connection to use your location. Please open it from a link starting with H T T P S.
errors.NETWORK_SPOKEN: Cannot reach the map service. If navigating, stop somewhere safe and check your connection.
errors.RATE_LIMITED_SPOKEN: The map service is temporarily rate limited. If navigating, stop somewhere safe. Wait and try again.
errors.NOT_FOUND: No walking route to this destination
errors.NOT_FOUND_SPOKEN: No walking route to this destination was found. Please choose a closer destination.
errors.PROVIDER_ERROR_SPOKEN: The map service is temporarily unavailable. If navigating, stop somewhere safe and retry.
errors.NO_POSITION: Your location is not known yet
errors.NO_POSITION_SPOKEN: Your location is not known yet, so a route cannot be calculated. Please wait until the app finds your location, then try again.
errors.UNKNOWN_SPOKEN: An unexpected problem occurred. If navigating, stop somewhere safe and retry.
errors.routeFailedSpoken: The route could not be calculated after several attempts. Navigation has stopped. Please stop somewhere safe and try again.
errors.speechUnsupported: App speech is unavailable in this browser. Use an enabled screen reader and test its announcements before starting.

hazard.crossroadsSpoken: Caution. A junction may be ahead. The map cannot check traffic or crossing signals. Do not cross based only on this app.
hazard.majorRoadSpoken: Caution near {{street}}. Traffic may be present. The map cannot confirm a safe crossing.
hazard.disclaimer: Hazard warnings come from open map data, which does not say whether a pedestrian crossing or traffic signal actually exists. Always rely on your own judgement.

sos.buttonLabel: Request help. Activate to prepare a message, or hold for three seconds. Nothing is sent automatically.
sos.holdingSpoken: Keep holding for three seconds to send for help. Lift your finger to cancel.
sos.cancelledSpoken: Emergency request cancelled. Nothing was sent.
sos.sendingSpoken: Opening your messaging app with your location. Please press send in the messaging app.
sos.copiedSpoken: The emergency message with your location has been copied. Please paste it into the app you want to send it from.
sos.noContactSpoken: No emergency contact is set and this device cannot share the message. Please add an emergency contact number in the settings.
sos.noPositionSpoken: Your location is not known yet, so help cannot be sent. Please wait until the app finds your location.
sos.hintWithContact: Hold for 3 seconds to send your location to {{name}}
sos.hintNoContact: Hold for 3 seconds to share your location. Adding an emergency contact in advance is recommended.
sos.messageTemplate: I need help. My location is {{latitude}}, {{longitude}} (accurate to about {{accuracy}} meters) at {{time}}. Map: {{url}}
sos.confirmHint: Check the message and choose a recipient. Your messaging app opens for you to press Send. Nothing is sent automatically.
sos.withoutLocation: I need urgent help. My device cannot find my location. Please contact me.
sos.shareAction: Choose an app to send this message
sos.stale: These are last-known coordinates, not a current location. Tell your recipient.
sos.handedOff: Handed to the sharing app. Delivery to the recipient cannot be confirmed.

share.title: Send this location
share.activeUntil: Sharing is on. The link expires at {{time}}
share.snapshotNotice: Snapshot only. Sent links cannot be recalled. Recipients can copy the coordinates, even beyond the displayed expiry.
share.messageTemplate: I am on my way. Here is my location. This link expires at {{expires}}
share.startedSpoken: Sharing this location snapshot. It does not update automatically.
share.copiedSpoken: The location link has been copied. Please paste it into the app you want to send it from.
share.stoppedSpoken: Sharing session closed. Previously sent links still open until the displayed time.
share.autoStoppedSpoken: At the route endpoint. Sharing session closed. Previously sent links cannot be recalled.
share.noPositionSpoken: Your location is not known yet, so it cannot be shared.
share.notSent: Nothing shared. Sharing was cancelled or is unavailable.

sharedView.title: Shared location
sharedView.snapshotWarning: This is the location at the moment the sender shared it, not a live position. The marker will not move until they send a new link.
sharedView.expiredTitle: This link has expired or is not valid
sharedView.expiredBody: Shared location links expire for safety. Please ask the sender for a new link.

settings.contactsPrivacy: Saved numbers stay on your device only and are never sent to any server.
settings.vibrationUnsupported: This device does not support vibration (for example iPhone on Safari). Speech will be used on its own.
settings.clearDataConfirmSpoken: Delete saved contacts and display settings? Choose Confirm deletion or Cancel. There is no time limit.
settings.clearDataDoneSpoken: Saved contacts and display settings deleted.
settings.clearDataNote: Deletes emergency contacts and display settings. Language, voice preference and browser caches are not removed.
settings.storageFailed: Changes could not be saved or deleted on this device. Do not rely on emergency contacts remaining after closing the app.

offline.banner: Offline: search and new routes are unavailable. Check your route and surroundings.
offline.lostSpoken: Offline. Search and new routes are unavailable. Stop somewhere safe if you leave the route.
offline.restoredSpoken: Your device is connected to a network. Retry any failed requests.

update.title: New version available
update.available: A new version of the app is ready
update.waitUntilStopped: Update available. Stop navigation before updating.

voice.title: Spoken guidance
voice.readerHint: Guidance is announced by your screen reader. Choose this mode when VoiceOver or TalkBack is enabled to avoid two voices.
voice.appHint: Use this mode without a screen reader. Test your audio and volume before travelling.
voice.testMessage: Taa-Thip audio test. Check that you can hear this clearly before travelling.
voice.failed: App speech failed to start or stopped unexpectedly. Stop somewhere safe. Check the installed voice language and volume, or use your screen reader. Test speech again before continuing.

nearby.title: Find nearby
nearby.hint: Pick a category and the app finds what is around you, nearest first
nearby.searchingSpoken: Searching around you. This may take a moment.
nearby.resultsSpoken_one: Found {{count}} place within {{radius}}. Tap it to set it as your destination.
nearby.resultsSpoken_other: Found {{count}} places within {{radius}}. Tap one to set it as your destination.
nearby.noResultsSpoken: Nothing found within {{radius}}. Try the widen search button.
nearby.unavailable: Nearby search is unavailable right now — the map data service is not responding
nearby.unavailableSpoken: Nearby search is unavailable right now because the map data service is not responding. Please try again, or search by place name instead.

obstacle.title: Obstacles on the route
obstacle.none: No obstacles recorded in the map data
obstacle.noneSpoken: No obstacles are recorded in the map data for this route, but please keep using your cane as usual.
obstacle.failedSpoken: Could not check for obstacles. This does not mean the route is clear. Please walk with extra care.
obstacle.disclaimer: Only obstacles recorded in the map data can be found — such as steps, gates and construction. It cannot detect parked motorcycles, street stalls, bins or standing signs. Always use your cane.
obstacle.stepsSpoken: Caution. In {{distance}} there are steps {{direction}} {{count}} {{handrail}}. Please check the first step with your cane before stepping.
obstacle.barrierSpoken: Caution. In {{distance}} there is a gate or bollard across the path.
obstacle.kerbSpoken: Caution. In {{distance}} there is a raised kerb to step over.
obstacle.constructionSpoken: Caution. In {{distance}} there is a construction zone. The path may be closed or diverted. Please slow down and ask for help if needed.
obstacle.crossing_no_tactileSpoken: Caution. In {{distance}} there is a crossing without tactile paving.
